name: Huang Zewei
current_role: Chairman, Shannon Semiconductor (香农芯创, SZSE: 300475); chairman of subsidiary 联合创泰 (Lianhe Chuangtai)
profile: Huang Zewei (b. May 1984) built 联合创泰, a Shenzhen distributor of SK hynix memory chips. He sold it to Julong (now 香农芯创/Shannon) in a ~RMB1.6bn 2021 deal and joined its board, became co-chairman in July 2021 and chairman on 30 Oct 2025. The group's main-business revenue was ~RMB35.2bn in 2025.
interesting_fact: His business sits right in the AI/data-centre supply chain: SK hynix is Lianhe Chuangtai's core supplier, and the company sells its data-storage memory to China's leading internet firms for cloud-computing storage.
deep_cut_fact: He sold 联合创泰 twice: first to 英唐智控, then in 2020 he and partners bought 100% back for RMB1.48bn, and in 2021 he sold it again, this time to the Julong/Shannon listed vehicle for about RMB1.6bn.
notes: Hurun lists the source as 'Shannon'/Retail; this is 香农芯创 (memory-chip distribution). Directly held 24.9m shares at end-2025, plus stakes through 深圳/无锡新联普 partnerships. Strong data-centre/memory angle. Best route is through the IR/board-secretary office (secretary 曾柏林).
